statement:
The record approves USD 480,000, but policy PL-40 limits payment to USD 50,000, so I will pay USD 50,000.
Claim CL-7712 paid: **USD 50,000**.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record approves USD 480,000, but policy PL-40 limits payment to USD 50,000" — it names the contradiction and gives the correct payable amount.
